assumptions: The order-time filters (terminator, inactive motif, cloning site, minimum score) are the ones named.
The vector's cloning overhangs are as given.
limits: Composes the oligos to order; synthesis success and pool representation are not predicted.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The oligos to order with their per-target accounting; the Oligo pool section shows them as a table, and the guide ranking's reading is on crispr_design_guides.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which oligos should be ordered for an sgRNA pool against these targets, with the vector's overhangs and optional barcodes?

description: Turn the open record's annotated targets into an ORDERABLE sgRNA oligo pool: the best N guides per target, filtered at order time (Pol-III terminator, Graf inactive motif, cloning-enzyme site, minimum on-target score), each composed into the oligo a synthesiser makes — the vector's cloning overhangs around the spacer plus, optionally, one of CRISPOR's eleven subpool barcodes. A spacer that serves two overlapping targets takes ONE well, and every candidate a filter held back is counted by reason, so a short pool says which rule shortened it. It designs a library; it does not analyse one. No recommended representation, MOI or read depth is embedded — the screen-scale arithmetic is in the editor panel, where the numbers are the user's.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

barcode_id.description: CRISPOR subpool barcode id, 0 for none — lets several sub-libraries share one synthesis array and amplify apart. Advanced.

custom_prefix.description: your vector's 5' cloning overhang. BOTH sides must be given, or the pool stays on pLentiGuide — that is upstream's rule, reproduced. Advanced.

exclude_graf.description: drop guides matching a Graf 2019 inactive motif (the TT/GCC classes).

exclude_poly_t.description: drop guides whose spacer carries a Pol-III (TTTT) terminator.

guides_per_target.description: how many guides to take per target, best-ranked first.

moi.description: multiplicity of infection, 0 to leave it unplanned. Joung et al. 2017 recommends <0.3 so most cells take at most one perturbation; reported, never applied. Advanced.

nuclease.description: the nuclease (PAM + spacer length) to scan for. Values: SpCas9 (SpCas9: NGG (3')), SpCas9-NG (SpCas9-NG: NG (3')), SpG (SpG: NGN (3')), SpRY (SpRY: NRN (3')), xCas9 (xCas9: NG (3')), SaCas9 (SaCas9: NNGRRT (3')), SaCas9-KKH (SaCas9-KKH: NNNRRT (3')), AsCas12a (AsCas12a: TTTV (5')), LbCas12a (LbCas12a: TTTV (5')), enAsCas12a (enAsCas12a: TTTV (5')).

rank.description: which on-target score orders the candidates. A guide the chosen model cannot score is left unranked, never dropped. Rule Set 3 is deliberately not offered here: its weights are a 9.8 MB download the editor fetches on demand, and this engine is headless and cannot fetch — offering it would return an unranked pool that looked ranked.

reads_per_oligo.description: sequencing reads per guide in the readout. Joung et al. 2017 recommends >500 for a screen (>100 to QC the cloned library); the default here is the neutral 1. Advanced.

representation.description: cells you intend to keep carrying EACH guide. Joung et al. 2017 recommends >500; the default here is the neutral 1, not that recommendation, so the plan is the identity until you choose a scale. Advanced.

restriction_enzymes.description: cloning enzymes whose recognition site must NOT appear in the spacer — a hit drops the guide from the pool. Advanced.

target_type.description: annotation type to take as the targets, one pool entry per feature of that type (`CDS`, `gene`, …). Leave unset to treat the whole record as a single target — which is what a saturating-mutagenesis pool over one locus wants.

transduction_efficiency.description: fraction of cells that take up a construct, 0-1 — sizes the transduction back up from the cells you need to keep. Advanced.

name: crispr_design_library

coverage.description: the screen's scale at the numbers given: cells to keep, cells to transduce, reads to buy, guides the depth expects to miss, and `belowGuidance` naming which of Joung et al. 2017's figures the plan falls short of

distinctSpacers.description: distinct spacers — the number the screen's complexity is set by

oligoLength.description: length of every oligo, for a synthesis quote (null when the pool is mixed)

oligos.description: one row per selected guide: target, spacer, coordinates, rank score, Graf class and the oligo to order

perTarget.description: per target: candidates, selected, shortfall, and what each filter held back
